scope_rule: Preserve the traditional 306 clinicopathologic vocabulary and high-yield LM/IF/EM patterns, but do not let historical morphology labels become false one-to-one etiologic ontology. Pattern/entity boundaries are part of Current Knowledge quality, not an excuse to modernize away exam-relevant classifications.

source_review.primary: 内科_27内科精编版合集_带导图.pdf; exact original PDF routes re-read for the glomerular sequence
source_review.visual_note: Exact original-source page routing is verified. The current file tool did not expose image pixels for every requested page, so this audit does not claim full pixel-level visual verification; canonical Visual Gates remain required source contact.
source_review.external_adjudication_role: Used only where historical compression turns a pathology pattern into an unconditional disease/etiology or treatment rule; not used to expand 306 Core into a modern nephrology textbook.

findings.historical_state: B9 presented the traditional pathology labels as a compact second coordinate that could be misread as mutually exclusive etiologic entities.
findings.adjudication: Keep the traditional 306 pathology index, but explicitly separate clinical syndrome, LM/IF/EM morphology/immune pattern and final etiologic disease. Mesangial proliferative, MPGN and FSGS are especially pattern-first.
findings.resolution: Applied in B9 framework, biopsy boundary, FSGS range language and final dual-coordinate algorithm.

findings.historical_state: Deposit location and immune-pattern shortcuts could be read as a deterministic nephritic-vs-nephrotic lookup table.
findings.adjudication: Keep the mechanistic tendency—subendothelial/endocapillary injury tends inflammatory/nephritic and subepithelial/podocyte-side injury tends heavy proteinuria—but never make location a unique syndrome or cause function.
findings.resolution: Applied in B9 KP07 and the high-density dual-coordinate table boundary.

findings.historical_state: Traditional RPGN III shorthand strongly coupled pauci-immune crescentic GN with ANCA positivity.
findings.adjudication: Type III is pauci-immune crescentic GN, commonly ANCA-associated. ANCA-negative pauci-immune GN exists, so ANCA is high-value etiologic/supporting evidence rather than a logical requirement of the morphology.
findings.resolution: Applied in B9 handoff and B10 KP13-KP14; systemic vasculitis remains deferred.

findings.historical_state: The exam route strongly associated IgA nephropathy with mesangial proliferation and could be read as a fixed LM identity.
findings.adjudication: Mesangial-dominant/co-dominant IgA on IF is the stable identity anchor. Mesangial proliferation is common/high-yield but LM is variable; EM often shows mesangial/paramesangial deposits.
findings.resolution: Applied in B10 KP17-KP20 and final algorithm. Oxford prognostic expansion remains out of scope.

findings.historical_state: B10 still carried old absolute ACEI/ARB creatinine contraindication language after B7 had already repaired the Current RAS-blockade owner.
findings.adjudication: Chronic-GN RAS-blockade Current Core must inherit B7 monitoring/clinical-boundary logic. Old numeric cutoffs remain 306 exam Precision only.
findings.resolution: Applied in B10 KP24 and Source Boundary K10-SB03.

findings.historical_state: The traditional MCD/membranous/MsPGN/MPGN/FSGS comparison set could be misread as five same-level single-cause entities.
findings.adjudication: Preserve the classic 306 LM/IF/EM recognition table while marking MsPGN, MPGN and FSGS as morphology/clinicopathologic patterns whose cause can vary. MCD and membranous retain their classic exam identities but still allow secondary etiologies.
findings.resolution: Applied in B11 framework, KP17-KP24 and traditional five-pattern index.

findings.historical_state: Traditional tables attached steroid sensitivity/resistance and cyclophosphamide pairings directly to pathology labels.
findings.adjudication: Keep 306 treatment tendencies as Source Precision. MCD is typically steroid-responsive; traditional primary FSGS is less responsive, but an FSGS lesion alone does not own immunosuppression. MsPGN/MPGN treatment also requires etiologic context.
findings.resolution: Applied in B11 KP10-KP12 and final syndrome→pattern→etiology→treatment algorithm.

findings.historical_state: MCD was still described as if a pure charge-barrier defect were the sole Current mechanism, conflicting with the accepted B2 podocyte/slit-diaphragm owner.
findings.adjudication: Keep the classical size/charge exam model, but Current mechanism inherits B2: podocyte/slit-diaphragm functional injury with foot-process effacement; do not invent one missing charge molecule as the sole explanation.
findings.resolution: Applied in B11 KP13-KP14 and Source Boundary K11-SB03.
